response.sql: WITH per_group AS (SELECT CENTROMEA, AVG(HGB) AS avg_hgb, AVG(`T-BIL` / CRE) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1985-04-22' AND '1994-03-14' GROUP BY CENTROMEA), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_mean FROM per_group) SELECT p.CENTROMEA, p.avg_hgb, p.avg_ratio, CASE WHEN o.overall_mean IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE p.avg_ratio / o.overall_mean END AS ratio_to_overall_mean FROM per_group p CROSS JOIN overall o

assumptions.assumption: Laboratory.Date is stored as YYYY-MM-DD text, so the string BETWEEN compares chronologically. The schema documentation says YYMMDD, which conflicts with the '0000-00-00' default, and the request says to compare the text as stored.

A missing CENTROMEA is SQL NULL. GROUP BY places all NULL statuses in one group, and that group is reported with a NULL status. Per-test ratios with NULL or zero CRE or T-BIL evaluate to NULL and are skipped by AVG, and a group whose ratio average is NULL gets a NULL ratio. The overall mean is the unweighted AVG over the group averages, skipping NULL groups, and the ratio is NULL when that mean is NULL or zero.
